subject.title: cli-backend agent runs against anthropic (claude-cli runtime) return 401 authentication_failed while identical claude invocation works in shell

question: Should OpenClaw change the managed claude-cli runtime/auth boundary for this LaunchAgent plus loopback-MCP 401 path, or treat the failure as external Claude CLI/macOS credential state after live proof?
rationale: The source path matches the report, but the root cause depends on live macOS Claude CLI OAuth, service context, MCP config, and keychain behavior; changing the managed auth boundary without that proof could trade one provider failure for another.

options.title: Run live LaunchAgent proof first
options.body: Reproduce managed cron/channel execution against Claude CLI OAuth and compare it with same-service shell replays before changing code.

options.title: Limit current work to re-auth messaging
options.body: Let the #97553 PRs improve expired-token recovery text while keeping this issue open for the managed execution failure.

options.title: Close only if it matches external setup
options.body: Close as external setup only if new proof matches the resolved #95367 Keychain/GUI login failure mode.

recommendation.title: Run live LaunchAgent proof first
recommendation.body: Reproduce managed cron/channel execution against Claude CLI OAuth and compare it with same-service shell replays before changing code.

likelyOwner.reason: This choice centers on the CLI runner, MCP, and managed environment boundary where steipete has the strongest feature-history signal.
